author: Samot
html: Clickbait. This has nothing to do with the “internals”. There are few things that could be less “internal” than the PUBLIC API of the ComponenScan annotation.

author: Fantaman
html:
The code snippet given as example for basePackageClasses() is actually just another example for basePackages. It should be corrected to e.g.

@ComponentScan(basePackageClasses = {"com.bsmlabs.microservices.movie", "com.bsmlabs.microservices.payment"})
public class MovieApplication {
}

And the explanation for “scopedProxy” says that “developers should create proxies” – it should probably be “the framework” or “ApplicationContext” instead of developers.
